identity: Canonical me id/team/role/session_version before and after requests/decode; profile.gym_id must equal persisted team or own id; session invalidation clears previews/fields/plan-price rows and disables old-context actions
private_read: GET /api/gym/logo with Bearer, no query tokens, no-store/no-referrer; MIME/png/jpeg/webp, 1..2MB, decoded <=16MP then actual img.decode before success
private_flag: has_private_logo=true always uses fixed private API; never fallback to legacy even when missing/404
legacy: Only current origin and /static/uploads/logos/<simple basename>.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp), no query/hash, credentials, subdirectories or external provider URLs. Legacy transport bytes are browser doubles in this author gate, not an automatic migration/import/deletion
upload: Explicit POST multipart once per user file selection; no network-error auto retry. A confirmed save followed by preview failure is described as saved with unavailable preview; ambiguous response directs a separate read-only reload
memory: No branding payload/file/blob/data URI saved to browser storage or analytics; old Blob URL revoked on replacement/pagehide/identity change
profile: Reloading the logo preserves unsaved profile inputs. Explicit save is identity-fenced. Read-only team members cannot edit and backend RBAC remains authority
pdf_cutover: History availability uses tiene_pdf with legacy metadata fallback only when field is absent; generation and both changed rows download exact plan id via Bearer. Raw PDF filesystem paths are not rendered or used as download destinations
real_browser: Authenticated logo POST/read/private local object persistence
Real invalid image rejection and 401/404/read-vs-update RBAC
Real saved upload/read responses held across different-account changes
Two actual worker-generated private PDFs using saved logo, current DTOs and exact old-row download bytes
transport_doubles: Legacy profile URLs and allowed legacy image response
csp_dependency: Root allowed blob only in img-src; middleware regression is separately owned by root. New preview code awaits decoding so CSP/render errors become visible instead of a false success
